title: Read Market Evidence Without Inventing a Signal

episodes.title: Put Every SEC Filing on the Right Clock
episodes.subtitle: Transaction date, period covered and EDGAR acceptance time prevent stale disclosures from becoming false live signals.

episodes.title: What Options Activity Can Actually Prove
episodes.subtitle: Volume, open interest and off-exchange reports describe activity without identifying the complete position or motive.

episodes.title: Short Interest Is a Delayed Position Snapshot
episodes.subtitle: Positions, short-sale transactions, settlement failures and borrow quotes answer different questions on different clocks.

episodes.title: A Verification Ladder for News and Sentiment
episodes.subtitle: Trace the claim, preserve its first reliable timestamp and measure attention without pretending to know intent.

episodes.title: Put Earnings and Analyst Notes on One Timeline
episodes.subtitle: A forecast made before results and a target changed afterward are different evidence, even if a data screen mixes them.

episodes.title: The Evidence Ledger
episodes.subtitle: Incompatible observations should retain their own clocks, scopes and unknowns instead of becoming votes.
